ug_station_guard.text: Please keep behind the yellow line. Please keep behind the yellow line. Please keep behind... oh. Hello. You're in the wrong tunnel. Everyone is.
There are 272 stations on the Tube. Some people try to visit them all in a day. It's called the Tube Challenge, and it's one of those things that sounds bad but is secretly delightful.

ug_cleaner.text: The mice here are famous. They ride the escalators. I've seen one with a ticket. Clearly an annual pass.
Rumour is something big lives in the old tunnels. Every time I look, it's just a mole in a hi-vis jacket. I'm choosing to believe it's a mole.
